snippet.title: Xevious Resurrection Gameplay (Playstation Network)
snippet.description: A gameplay video of the new Xevious Resurrection, part of the upcoming Namco Museum Essentials for Playstation Network in July 2009. It is was first released in Japan as Namco Museum.comm.
